reason: An MCP service that connects agents to Gemini web chat, media analysis, image and video generation, conversation management, and media downloads using browser session cookies and unofficial internal interfaces; human review is warranted because it handles account credentials and performs external account operations.

summaries.zh: 通过浏览器会话 Cookie 将 Gemini 网页端的对话、媒体分析、图像与视频生成及会话管理能力接入 MCP 智能体。
summaries.en: An MCP service that connects agents to Gemini web conversations, media analysis, image and video generation, conversation management, and media downloads through browser session cookies.

capabilities: Bridges an MCP client to Gemini web conversations through unofficial internal interfaces
Reads and uses Google session cookies from browser storage or exported cookie files
Uploads local images and videos for analysis
Generates and downloads images and videos
Lists, reads, and permanently deletes conversation history
Maintains and renews session cookies in a local file
Exposes an HTTP MCP transport with bearer-token authentication
